verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state 'Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec' at the API reference introduction, and a runtime probe confirms machine-readable per-tag OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON specs are downloadable keylessly (e.g. incidents-v2.json). Missing for 10: no evidence of a single consolidated full-spec file being probed directly (only per-tag files verified) and no independent third-party corroboration of spec quality/tooling generation.
